title: fix(scenarios): judge the bare-name Build check only where ADR-0150 keeps the literal prefix
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCPAmC6XoinFYKSk7wgQt4T)_
Fixes #31729

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:场景评分器的 `bare-name` 构建检查只再判视图、文档、岗位(`NS_SHORT`)和能力(`NS.SHORT`);流程、动作、作业、工具、仪表盘、权限集等行为元数据裸名不再判失败;构建与迭代提示词的命名规则同步收窄。
- **为什么改**:ADR-0150 已把 bucket 2–4 类型改为按(软件包, 名称)寻址,忠实按新规则命名的应用不应在评分和画廊导出时被判构建失败;须与 #31669(child P,撤销 lint 与技能文案)同时或更早落地,避免评分器、技能、模板教出两套规则。
- **风险与回滚**:只影响评分规则与提示词文本,不动任何平台解析或 spec;回滚即 revert 本 PR。能力名写成 `NS_SHORT` 现在会判失败(此前通过),与 ADR-0150 D1 的 `NS.SHORT` 拼写一致。
- **先看**:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-naming.ts`(判哪些类型、能力的点号前缀);`packages/qa/scenarios/test/score/entry.test.ts` 末段(读取 ADR-0150 D1 表格的钉子测试);`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/prompts.ts` 的 `namingRule`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/score/entry.test.ts`,预期 14 个用例全绿,其中裸流程/动作/工具/作业通过、裸岗位/视图失败、无 `NS.SHORT` 的能力失败。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `gradeItemNames` (`src/score/scenario-naming.ts`) judges only the manifest collections that hold a type ADR-0150 keeps on the global literal prefix: D1's bucket 1 (`object`, `field`, `object_extension`, `view`, `capability`, `doc`) and the position (D7, one environment-wide slot per name). Of the collections the scorer walks that is views, docs and positions, named `NS_SHORT`, and capabilities, named `NS.SHORT`. Objects stay out (`defineStack` judges them); an api item's `name` is bucket 2 and passes. Every other bare name (flow, action, job, tool, skill, agent, app, page, dashboard, permission set, …) is no finding.
- **Where the bucket list comes from.** Child P (#31669) has no PR open and its branch (`b7acc113`) exports no per-type bucket from the platform; its list is cli-local. So the list is restated from ADR-0150 D1's table in a comment and a module-private constant, and `test/score/entry.test.ts` reads the ADR's bucket-1 and position rows and fails when either row changes, or when the types the check judges stop being exactly the rows' types the manifest walks. Once P (or R) exports the bucket of each type, the constant moves to read it, tracked on #31669. Nothing new is exported from `./score`.
- `namingRule` (`src/runner/prompts.ts`), used by the build, iterate and template-iterate prompts, asks for `NS_` on objects, views, docs and positions and `NS.` on capabilities, says every other item needs no prefix, and keeps "where this prompt names an item, use that exact name" so the stated names (persona permission sets, dashboards, agent actions) still match the Build half's exact-name checks.
- Prose this makes false is corrected (claim amendment 6730010093): the `namespace.ts` and `scenarioNamespace` docblocks, the `naming` field docblock in `scenario-tags.ts`, and README's Namespaces bullet. `namespace.ts` still prefixes the card's own names, so the prompt and the Build half keep one spelling.
- The ADR file the pin reads is declared as a scenarios test input (claim amendments 6730243476 and 6730537694): `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` (the `@objectstack/scenarios` globs), root `turbo.json` (`@objectstack/scenarios#test` inputs), and `scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`, whose rollback pin counts declared globs under the `docs/**` root (22 → 23, recorded by name).
- Changeset `31729-scenario-naming-literal-prefix.md`, `patch` on `@objectstack/scenarios` (published).

## Tests

- `test/score/entry.test.ts`: a bare flow, action, tool, job, dashboard, permission set and api name pass; a bare position, view and doc fail, and a capability spelled `export_data` or `democrm_export_data` fails while `democrm.refund` passes, each one counted check; the ADR-0150 D1 pin; the multi-package case now finds a bare view under `packages[]`.
- `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`: the bare-items build now yields only the view finding (build and iterate build); the bare dashboard is no finding.
- `test/runner/units.test.ts`: every authoring prompt states the narrowed rule and no longer says "EVERY metadata item".

## Acceptance notes

- Serial with #31669: P has no PR yet. `git merge-tree --write-tree` of head `edb1f41b` against P's branch head `b7acc113` is clean, and the two diffs share no file.
- ADR-0150 D9's hand-off line is executed as written: view, doc and capability keep the check, plus positions.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local runs (code at head 805f90e2; 947b0404 adds only the changeset)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build && … test && … typecheck` under the verify lock: build ok, Test Files 31 passed (31), Tests 618 passed (618), typecheck exit 0 (`tsc --listFiles` includes the three edited test files).
- Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob after: (1) judging every collection again: 4 tests red (bucket 2-4 pass, ADR pin, multi-package, orchestrate); (2) capability prefix `NS_` instead of `NS.`: the position/view/doc/capability test red; (3) adding `` `dashboard` `` to the ADR-0150 D1 bucket-1 row: the ADR pin red.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 82 families on the final tree, code at `8b3f7e4e`/`edb1f41b`): 81 exit 0, reconciled with `--ran` (0 unrun). `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` is NOT MEASURED locally (exit 3, needs a full workspace build), left to CI. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 0 after fetching its pinned fixture. `check:pm-dispatch-gates` exit 0 (2205 cases). `check:cross-package-test-inputs` and `check:ci-filter-parity` were red before the input declarations and exit 0 after.
- `origin/main` (`0105a687` and three more) merged at `edb1f41b`; it touches none of this PR's files, so nothing above was re-run.

</details>
